scope: Human escalation versus ordinary support routing slice
purpose: Human escalation versus ordinary support routing slice

inputs.high_risk: Optional field (may be missing), named in local snapshot contract
inputs.message: Optional field (may be missing), named in local snapshot contract

preconditions: Single ticket snapshot; declared input fields may be absent; counters/flags trusted
ordered_activities: Escalate high risk to human_support; otherwise assign standard_support
actions: Escalate high risk to human_support; otherwise assign standard_support
exceptions_and_escalation: See conditional activities; no external side effects
expected_outputs: Local ticket state and operation trace

forbidden_actions.reason: Local simulator has no authority to transfer money; vendor example mentions a refund notification only.

postconditions: Independent case assertions hold on supported fixtures

source_backed_requirements.description: High-risk tickets escalate to a human; ordinary tickets use ordinary support; record either outcome
source_backed_requirements.expected_evidence: Independent state/trace assertions across the named fixtures

simulation_assumptions: high_risk is a trusted precomputed boolean; no numerical threshold is invented.
human_support and standard_support are simulator group identifiers, not vendor policy names.
limitations: No Gemini classification, Slack, deduplication, policy retrieval or daily summaries.
